Resolves #19560

Dependabot's pull requests here now merge themselves once `dev`'s required checks pass. The new caller, `.github/workflows/dependabot-automerge.yml`, hands them to the published Skills workflow (`reusable-dependabot-automerge.yml@v0.1.35`), as the operator decided on 2026-10-10: *"dependabot: ALL PRs once CI is green. no limitations."* The job runs only on pull requests Dependabot opened. Another account's push onto one takes the arming back, so a fix a peer pushes still waits for a human merge.

**Merge precondition (operator):** `dev`'s ruleset requires only the ten `baseline / …` jobs and `build-all`. GitHub's auto-merge waits on required checks alone, so add `unit`, `components (1/3–3/3)`, `e2e-engine (1/3–3/3)` and `lint` to the ruleset before merging this. Otherwise a bump that breaks the unit tests merges.

Evidence: L1 (one workflow file; its own pull request skips the job) → L4 required for AC-2 (the next Dependabot pull request merging itself). Residual: AC-2, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-skills#14.
